coastal.title: Drivers should expect major delays on Sea to Sky during GranFondo
coastal.description: The Sea to Sky Highway between Horseshoe Bay and Whistler is limited to single-lane traffic until 4 p.m. on Saturday.

coastal.title: Former Vancouver International Airport staff recall 9/11 on 25th anniversary
coastal.description: People who were involved in YVR's response to 9/11 say it was all hands on deck as airport staff and community members scrambled to receive 34 rerouted flights and thousands of passengers.

prince-george.title: Chetwynd, B.C., apartment fire displaces nearly 50 people
prince-george.description: Firefighters responded to a fire the Hillside Manor apartments around 4 a.m. on Tuesday, Sept. 8, where officials say at least one unit was destroyed and several others damaged.

northwest.title: Northeast B.C. interested in strengthening health care with non-profit medical centre being built in Alberta
northwest.description: The non-profit Maskwa Medical Centre being built in Grande Prairie, Alta., is continuing to attract interest from municipal leaders in northeast B.C.
